title: Chapter 225: Going To The Xie Clan
content:
Chapter 225: Going To The Xie Clan

Seeing this, Xiao Yin nodded and was about to leave.

But then, Xiao Yin seemed to feel something and frowned slightly.

Not far away, the other powerful people of the Xiao clan were the same.

The next moment, Xiao Yin and several powerful people from the Xiao clan rose into the sky and stood in the void.

boom!

The terrifying deterrent power surged out of the body of Xiao Yin and other powerful people of the Xiao clan, instantly covering the entire Xiao clan, and the aftermath spread beyond the Xiao clan.

"I dare to spy on my Xiao clan again, and I will be killed without mercy!"

Xiao Yin's face suddenly changed, and cold words like thousands of years of mysterious ice poured out from Xiao Yin's mouth. Accompanied by the peak of his Immortal Emperor Realm, it immediately spread with the Xiao clan as the center.

At this moment, almost half of the fairyland heard this sound.

Feeling the terrifying emperor's power mixed in the voice, the world trembled.

Outside the Xiao clan, in just a moment, all the aura in the dark escaped and fled.

"The peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, what a strong aura."

The figure who escaped in secret was still scared.

The Xiao clan actually has such powerful combat power, and it seems that there is more than one.

It seems that the Xiao clan is about to rise again.

At this time, Xiao Yin and other powerful people also slowly fell from the void.

"Sorry, Miss Lu, I made you laugh."

Xiao Yin smiled politely at Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Lu Xue shook her head and said, "A small matter."

"Miss Lu, aren't you going to take a walk around my Xiao clan? I'll lead the way."

Xiao Luo enthusiastically headed towards the snow road.

Looking at Xiao Luo, Lu Xue was silent for a moment and suddenly said, "By the way, when the battle just now, I saw that someone in the Xie clan saved your life. Now your tribe is going to destroy the Xie clan. Don't you do anything. ? ”

As soon as these words came out, Xiao Yin also looked at Xiao Luo.

Someone from the Xie tribe saved Xiao Luo’s life?

She didn't know about this.

Including all the powerful Xiao clans who came out of the ancestral land, they didn't know.

After all, Xiao Luo has never mentioned it.

And now, Lu Xue said this and everyone immediately looked at Xiao Luo.

I saw that Xiao Luo was stunned for a moment, and his face suddenly turned terrified.

"Damn it! I forgot!!"

The Xiao clan became so strong in a very short period of time, which made Xiao Luo feel unresponsive for a while.

After Lu Xue reminded her, Xiao Luo remembered it.

Xie Clan still owe a favor.

"Sister Yin, I still owe someone a favor to Xie Clan. Can you help me?"

Xiao Luo hurriedly looked at Xiao Yin beside him and said anxiously.

Hearing this, Xiao Yin sighed, then turned to look at Lu Xue, showing apologies.

"Miss Lu, I,"

Lu Xue waved her hand.

"It doesn't matter,"

"That's good."

Immediately afterwards, Lu Xue continued, "Just bring me with you."

Suddenly, Xiao Yin and the others were stunned.

......

In the end, Xiao Yin took Xiao Luo and Lu Xue quickly towards the Xie clan.

On the way, Xiao Yin kept breaking through the void and moving forward, sparks and lightning along the way, directly interpreting what the true peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm is.

In less than a moment, the three of them arrived at the location of Xie tribe.

But at this time, the Xie clan felt very uncomfortable.

The last line of defense of the Xie clan, the protection formation had already been opened, and outside the protection formation.

Ten powerful people in the Immortal Emperor realm continued to use terrifying immortal attacks, and the killing power poured down.

The entire Xie clan was trembling wildly.

Among them, there are three peak powerhouses in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

There were originally very few peak strong people in the Immortal Emperor Realm. Large forces with such strong people generally do not have major issues. Basically, they will not send such strong people out.

A powerful force like the Ye clan has only three peak powerhouses at the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Now, the three peak Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses are approaching the Xiao clan. It seems that the Xiao clan vows to completely kill the Xie clan.

At this moment, under the repeated bombardment of ten powerful Immortal Emperor realm powerhouses, the extremely strong clan protection formation was already full of holes, as if it was about to be broken in the next moment.

"Xiao clan, do you really want to be so amazing?!"

In the Xie clan, an unwilling angrily shouted.

I saw that the patriarch of the Xie clan stared at the powerful Xiao clan in the void with anger.

Hearing this, a strong man led by the Xiao clan snorted coldly: "Since you dare to attack me, Xiao clan, you must be aware of being defeated by our Xiao clan in advance."

"You thank the clan, we will destroy it!"

Buzz —

A blood-red power of the law condensed wildly from his hands. The next moment, a force that faintly surpassed the Immortal Emperor Realm slowly overflowed from his hands.

Seeing this scene, the patriarch of Xie clan was pale and screamed in dismay: "You are crazy!"

Seeing this, the other Xiao people also changed their faces.

"Brother Zheng, stop!"

It can be seen from the naked eye that some of the strong man named Xiao Zheng's hair has begun to turn gray.

Obviously it has paid a big price.

Hearing the dissuasion of the tribes around him, Xiao Zheng's face was ferocious, "Today, even if I die, I will swear to make the Xie clan pay the price!"

Immediately, Xiao Zheng clenched his fist violently, and the terrifying power of the blood-colored law immediately merged into Xiao Zheng's fist.

boom!

Xiao Zhengchao took a step forward and rushed directly towards the Xie clan protection formation in front of him.

I saw a huge blood-colored fist mark rushing towards the Xie clan with the aura of destruction. At the same time, the entire void was shattered at this moment.

Another deafening explosion sounded.

The Xie clan’s protecting formation was completely shattered!

"kill!"

Xiao Zheng's eyes were red and he roared lowly.

It can be seen that Xiao Zheng thinks about the Xiao clan. He will never let anyone go of any evil things to the Xiao clan, no matter who it is or what force it is.

The other Xiao clan members seemed to be affected by Xiao Zheng's aura, and the murderous intent in their eyes at Xie clan became stronger and stronger.

Seeing this, the head of the Xie clan quickly shouted: "Give the Xie clan magic weapon and block them!"

After saying that, the patriarch of the Xie clan hurriedly retreated.

And at this moment, Xiao Yin's figure suddenly appeared in the Xie clan.

"Stop!"

Seeing Xiao Yin, everyone in the Xiao clan reacted first and stopped quickly.

"A Yin!?"

When the Xie tribe saw Xiao Yin, their faces became even more desperate.

Another peak strong man from the Immortal Emperor Realm came. Are their Xie clan really going to perish?

But the head of the Xie clan's eyes lit up because he saw Xiao Luo beside Xiao Yin, as if he had thought of something. He suddenly looked in the direction deep in the Xie clan.

At this time, Xiao Yin took Lu Xue and Xiao Luo toward Xiao Zheng and others.

"Dear uncles."

Xiao Zheng and others nodded suspiciously.

"A Yin, what are you doing with this child? Why? Are you afraid that we can't destroy the Xie clan?"

Hearing this, Xiao Yin smiled bitterly for a moment.

She saw a long way and knew the background of an ancient family very well.

With the strength of Xiao Zheng and others, it is really impossible to destroy the Xie clan, but if you want to severely damage the Xie clan, you can still do it.
